timetable._comment: Synthetic headways in timetable minutes by the game clock's time of day, per line and direction; `secondsPerMinute` is how many sim seconds a timetable minute lasts (the game clock runs 30 times faster than real time, so real minutes would be 30 game minutes apart: a 10-minute headway is 200 s here). Dwell at a station in sim seconds; the transfer station dwells longer.
